slides.title: Foreign investment in 3 months, as Ethiopia wins a UN award
The award
slides.body: UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD) gave Ethiopia's Investment Commission its 2026 Investment Promotion Award at the World Investment Forum in Doha. Its entry was picked from 48 entries from 40 countries.

slides.title: Why: digital investment
slides.body: UNCTAD cited the commission's role in investment in digital infrastructure. The Reporter points to Safaricom Ethiopia: 13.6 million active subscribers and 5.2 million M-PESA users as of March 2026.

slides.title: Official figures
slides.body: $1.432B in foreign investment in the first quarter of 2026/27, up 49%, and over 22,000 jobs, per figures reported by The Reporter. Not independently verified.
